messages.subject: MRO Install on OpenSuSe
parts:
I just installed MRO on OpenSuse. It installed, but when I try to install Rcmdr, it fails due to "Tlc/Tk support is not available on this system"   Rcmdr had worked on regular R on the same system.  Anyone else have this problem or know a solution?

thank you

Bob

messages.author: 9ca0345d553844f2
messages.subject: Re: MRO Install on OpenSuSe
parts:
Hi Bob,

Thanks for your report. We are investigating now. Looks like it might have been missing at build time. 

If you are pressed to move forward, you can always build it yourself from source. We'll continue looking into a fix.

Thanks,
Josée
